children: Gold prices stabilized on Sunday, October 18, with the24-karat gold hitting EGP 7,192.95 for purchase and EGP 7,095.46 for sale, according to Dahab Masr at 3:38 PM.
The 21-karat gold stood at EGP 6,294.46 for buying and EGP 6,209.15 for selling.
Meanwhile, the 18-karat hit EGP 5,395.25 for purchase and EGP 5,322.13 for sale.
A gold coin reached EGP 50,355.68 for buying and EGP 49,673.2 for selling.
Globally, the international ounce amounted to $4,165.8 for buying and $4.165 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt hold steady on October 18
